ttl.name: ABS with EBD & TRC & VSC & BA System

content5.ptxt: The skid control computer (built into the actuator) receives the signals of the engine control computer, steering sensor and yaw rate sensor via CAN communication.

item.ptxt: With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, a delay in receiving data from the deceleration sensor, yaw rate sensor or steering sensor continues for 1 seconds or more

With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, a condition in which a delay in receiving data from the deceleration sensor, yaw rate sensor or steering sensor occurs 1 times or more within 5 seconds occurs 10 times or more within 60 seconds
Transmission is not completed for 5 seconds or more after output from the skid control computer is completed
A condition in which a bus off state occurs 1 times or more within 100ms occurs 10 times consecutively

entry.ptxt: Skid control computer CAN communication line
With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher and a vehicle speed of 15km/h or more, data cannot be sent to or received from the engine control computer for 2 seconds or more
Communication Line between Skid Control Computer and Engine Control Computer

item.ptxt: With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, data cannot be received from the yaw rate sensor for 1 seconds or more
With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, a condition in which data cannot be received from the yaw rate sensor 1 times or more within 5 seconds occurs 10 times consecutively

entry.ptxt: Communication Line between Skid Control Computer and Yaw Rate Sensor

item.ptxt: With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, data cannot be received from the deceleration sensor for 1 seconds or more
With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, a condition in which data cannot be received from the deceleration sensor 1 times or more within 5 seconds occurs 10 times consecutively

entry.ptxt: Communication Line between Skid Control Computer and Deceleration Sensor

item.ptxt: With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, data cannot be received from the steering sensor for 1 seconds or more
With IG1 terminal voltage at 10to17.4V or higher, a condition in which data cannot be received from the steering sensor 1 times or more within 5 seconds occurs 10 times consecutively

entry.ptxt: Communication Line between Skid Control Computer and Steering Sensor

test1.ptxt: Record the DTCs that are output.

atten4.ptxt: If a CAN communication system malfunction DTC and a corresponding sensor malfunction DTC are output at the same time, troubleshoot the sensor malfunction code after the CAN communication malfunction returns to normal.

testgrp.testtitle: Go to CAN communication system troubleshooting
